applicant.name: Dr. Anna Kowalska
applicant.organisation: Medical University of Warsaw, Cardiology Research Unit

request.purpose: Health services research to improve the quality of care for patients with chronic conditions.
request.question: Which share of men aged 50 to 69 with hypertension is treated with an ARB, per region?
definitions: Age 50 to 69 = aged 50 to 69 on 31 December 2025.
Hypertension = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I10.
ARB = ATC code starting with C09CA.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per region: men aged 50 to 69 with hypertension and the share with an active ARB in %, one decimal.
